name: GET /api/admin/accounts/:id - Full account detail
description: Aggregate view of one account: profile, access state with reason and who changed it, subscription, trailing usage, team membership, document and workflow counts, and recent admin actions taken against it. password_hash is never selected. Read-only, so no step-up elevation required.

testCases.name: Get detail for a registered account

errorCases.when: The :id path parameter is not a valid UUID
The caller is authenticated but is not a platform_admin (a tenant-level admin is refused here)

errorCases.message: Platform administrator access has been revoked
errorCases.when: The admin's own access_status is suspended or revoked
No account exists with that id
